# References for the image types

Cited from memory; none was re-opened during this export. Check the citations before quoting them.

## Node-and-link connectome diagrams (levels 1-5)
- Sporns O. *Networks of the Brain.* MIT Press, 2010. Node-and-link figures of brain networks with modules, hubs and
  redundant paths; the source of the modular, redundant structure the generator imitates.
- nilearn `plot_connectome` (Python neuroimaging library): node-and-link connectivity plots, nodes coloured by module.

## Circular connectograms (level 6)
- Irimia A, Chambers MC, Torgerson CM, Van Horn JD. Circular representation of human cortical networks for subject
  and population-level connectomic visualization. *NeuroImage* 60(2), 2012. Regions on a ring grouped by lobe,
  connections as curves through the centre.

## Circuit notation (level 5)
- Kandel ER et al. *Principles of Neural Science.* Circuit diagrams draw excitatory synapses with arrowheads and
  inhibitory ones with flat bar ends, the convention level 5 uses.

## The reasoning asked for
- Dijkstra EW. A note on two problems in connexion with graphs. *Numerische Mathematik* 1, 1959 (fastest routes).
- Ford LR, Fulkerson DR. Maximal flow through a network. *Canadian Journal of Mathematics* 8, 1956; Menger's
  theorem (minimum cut = edge-disjoint paths).
